hook: Your hike in Antarctica ends at a blood-red waterfall.
title: Antarctica Has a Blood-Red Waterfall
description:
Blood Falls flows out of the Taylor Glacier in Antarctica's McMurdo Dry Valleys. The red colour comes from iron in very salty water that rusts when it meets air. It looks like bleeding ice, but it is not blood.

#Shorts #BloodFalls #Antarctica
comment_prompt: Would you visit it? Yes or no
